text.tspan: Written by
Memory: where it lives and how long
Read by (and for what)
Blob chat-state/<chat id>.json
The conversation of one chat about the latest digest:
digest snapshot, last 20 handled update ids, agent session
(history capped at ChatMaxMessages, first message kept)
Lives until the next digest or cleanup replaces it
Digest: new snapshot for every chat
Chat: the session after each turn (ETag)
Cleanup: deletes the stale ones
Chat agent: keeps the thread of
questions about this digest
(history and the digest it is about)
Blob settings/overrides.json
What the owner changed from the bot: values, sources,
alert sources, followed topics, the pending question and proposals
(each tied to a chat), last 30 handled menu updates
Lives until reset; shared by all chats
Settings menu and the button that
applies a proposal (SettingsProposals)
Chat tools add_watch, remove_watch
Every job, once per run (IEffectiveOptions):
Collector, Scorer, Digest, Alert, Chat
Chat tool get_settings
Blob settings/feedback.json
The reader's likes and dislikes of posts: topic, source, vote
(the latest 40, one vote per post, shared by all chats)
Lives until newer votes push it out
Chat tool rate_post: the reader
tells the agent (+, лайк, мінус)
Scorer: the recent votes go into
the scoring request as a hint
(only while FeedbackEnabled is true)
Blob settings/reader-memory/<chat id>/<yyyy-MM-dd>-<keywords>.md
Reader memory (ADR-0022): up to 10 Markdown notes about the reader
of one chat, one topic each, at most 50 lines (title, keywords, date, facts)
Lives until the agent replaces or forgets it; never cleaned
Chat tools save_memory, forget_memory:
the agent decides itself, a line
under the answer tells the reader
Chat agent: every note goes into
the instructions of each question
as data (<reader_memory>)
Blob settings/stats/daily/YYYY-MM-DD.json, stats/usage.json
Long memory (ADR-0018): a summary of each finished day (counts per
source and topic, best posts, no post text) and tokens per day
Kept StatsRetentionDays (90) and 30 days
DailySummaryJob writes the days
Model clients: count tokens (usage)
/stats, and the chat tool get_trends:
trends over weeks and the sources
that give the most interesting posts
Table Posts
Posts and bundles: text, score, topic, reason,
duplicate link, embedding, sent and alert marks
Partitioned by day, deleted by Cleanup after the retention
Collector: new posts
Embedding: vector; Scorer: score
Digest: marks posts as sent
Digest: picks what to send
Alert: hot discussions
Chat tools get_post and search_posts
(the wider picture, capped by ChatSearchMaxHits)
Table ChannelState
Read cursor of every source, never cleaned up
so that nothing is read twice
Collector: moves the cursor
Collector: where to continue
Table ChatBinding
One row per paired chat, at most TelegramMaxChats
Removed by the operator to unbind
Pairing: /start with the right key
Notifier and ChatResolver: who gets a message
Menu and Chat: is this chat allowed
Queue chat-messages
Questions on their way to the model (with chat id and
digest id). Short-term buffer, messages live one hour
Webhook: checks, then queues
Chat function: one message at a time
Not stored anywhere: the model's context for one turn (instructions, snapshot, history, tool results, each wrapped in a data block) is rebuilt per question.
The only long-lived memory about the reader is the settings, the reader memory notes and the recent votes; there is no history of old digests or conversations: a new digest starts a fresh one.
